newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chapman Freeborn cargo charter to Romania.
newsitem.headline: Chapman Freeborn cargo charter to Romania.

text.p: Air brokers Chapman Freeborn said an Illyushin 76 aircraft left Beauvais-Tille airport, in northern France, earlier on Thursday for Timisoara in Romania, carrying a 38-tonne shipment of telecommunications equipment.

"The aircraft was chartered by French telecoms equipment manufacturers, Egetra and Alcatel, who are supplying GSM infrastructure to Mobil Rom, a telephone operator in Romania," a Chapman Freeborn official told Reuters.
This flight was the last of a programme of three flights carrying telecoms equipment to Romania, using Ilyushin 76, the official said.
One of these two flights departed from Paris/CDG at the end of last month and the other from Beauvais last week. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
